title: Boom or bust: How to protect ratepayers from the AI bubble
notes: Recognized policy research institution; named authors (Klaus, MacCarthy). Cited for the 1 GW = 750,000 homes and 64 GW = 56 million homes conversion figures.
claims: US electricity rates up 30% since 2020, rising ~2x inflation
Up to five US data centers under construction each consume >= 1 GW = sufficient to power 750,000 homes
Proposed Meta LA data center: 70 football fields, $3B grid upgrade, up to 2.2 GW
IEA (Apr 2025): US data-center demand 180 TWh (2024) to 420 TWh (2030), +130%
Wood Mackenzie: 64 GW confirmed + 132 GW potential data-center power projects; 64 GW = enough to power 56 million homes
Developers want power in 2-3 years; new plants/transmission take 8-10 years
